items.title: JSW Steel expects higher H2 volumes to offset rising input costs

The growth was largely supported by higher volumes, improved operational efficiency and inventory dilution. Jayant Acharya, Joint Managing Director and CEO, JSW Steel, spoke to businessline on various aspects of business and demand outlook in Q2.

The scheme offers subsidised loans and credit guarantees for facilities such as warehouses, cold storages and processing centres to reduce crop losses.
